answer:
Configure a 2D transient incompressible laminar flow-past-cylinder simulation using the pimpleFoam solver in OpenFOAM.
The simulation domain is a single-cell-thick 2D slice with the cylinder centered at the origin and diameter D = 1.
The domain extends from x = -20 to x = +30 (inlet 20D upstream, outlet 30D downstream) and from y = -10 to y = +10, giving a 50D by 20D domain.
The frontAndBack patches in constant/polyMesh/boundary are defined with type empty.
The frontAndBack patches in 0/U are set with type empty and no value entry.
The inlet patch (x = -20) uses fixedValue in 0/U with value uniform (1 0 0), representing a freestream velocity of U_inf = 1.
The outlet patch (x = +30) uses inletOutlet with inletValue uniform (1 0 0) in 0/U.
The cylinderWall patch (circle of diameter 1 centered at origin) uses noSlip in 0/U with value uniform (0 0 0).
The top and bottom patches (y = +10 and y = -10) use symmetryPlane in both constant/polyMesh/boundary and 0/U.
The Reynolds number is Re = 100 based on D = 1 and U_inf = 1, giving a kinematic viscosity nu = 0.01 specified in constant/transportProperties.
The mesh uses boundary-layer refinement around the cylinder: approximately 80 cells around the cylinder circumference and a first-cell radial height of 0.005D with a growth ratio of 1.05 outward, for roughly 20 radial layers from the cylinder wall to the far field.
The mesh is graded toward the cylinder in the x-direction with roughly 200 cells in x and 160 cells in y, concentrated near the cylinder and the wake region.
The time step is 0.01 (giving a maximum Courant number of approximately 0.5 at the cylinder surface), with a total simulation time of 200 time units (about 32 vortex-shedding periods at Strouhal number approximately 0.164) to allow the periodic wake to fully develop.
The initial field in 0/U is set to uniform (1 0 0) everywhere except inside the cylinder, with a zeroGradient condition on p in 0/p and fixedValue zero at the outlet with zeroGradient elsewhere.
The pimpleFoam control dict uses 2 non-orthogonal correctors, the SIMPLE relaxation factor for U set to 0.7 and for p set to 0.3, and convergence tolerance of 1e-6 for both momentum and pressure.
The fvcScheme uses EulerDdt for time discretisation, Gauss upwind for div(phi,U), and Gauss linear for grad and laplacian schemes.
Simulation results are written every 10 time steps (writeControl timeStep, writeInterval 1000 steps at dt=0.01 giving write every 10 time units), with fields U and p written in plain ASCII for post-processing.
